channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Self-driving tech raise puts UK "at forefront of high-growth sectors" says lawyer involved
item.description: A lawyer at international firm Addleshaw Goddard has hailed a £37m investment in self-driving software business Oxa as driving the UK's ambition to lead in next-generation mobility.

item.title: Progress made on HS2's Curzon Street station with new CGI images unveiled
item.description: Engineers working for the HS2 project have completed the last of more than 2,000 concrete piles that will underpin the foundations of Birmingham's Curzon Street station, with new images published showing how the public spaces around the building will look.

item.title: Facilities management firm appointed at Basingstoke's Festival Place
item.description: Festival Place shopping centre in Basingstoke has appointed a new firm to provide facilities management services for the site.

item.title: Galliford Try strikes £10m deal for Northamptonshire fire door company
item.description: Construction giant Galliford Try has revealed its acquisition of a Northamptonshire-based fire door provider in an approximately £10m deal.

item.title: £15m Leeds sports hub nears final approval
item.description: The final go-ahead is expected to be given for work to start on a £15m sports hub in Leeds.

item.title: Government allocates £500m to UK space projects - "just the start" says minister
item.description: The UK government has laid out a £500m investment package to make Britain a "competitive, agile space power".

item.title: Law firm reveals role on pharmaceutical and biotech consultancy EOT
item.description: A Bristol-based team at law firm Thrings has supported a patient focused pharmaceutical and biotech consultancy in transitioning to an Employee Ownership Trust (EOT).

item.title: Pick Everard bolsters team with senior hire - "important step for our environmental services"
item.description: An environmental specialist has joined multi-disciplinary consultancy Pick Everard as associate director as the company looks to develop its regenerative construction services.

item.title: New chair for Telford and Shropshire Tourism Board
item.description: A new chair has been appointed to the Telford and Shropshire Tourism Board.

item.title: Milestone as angel investors back sustainable household goods firm
item.description: A Cheshire-based sustainable household goods company has secured £502,000 from angel investors, including the founder of Heler Foods, marking a milestone for the female-founded, family-run business.
